publication_authorization: Authorized scheduled maintenance of the National Trump Record. Publication remains subject to deterministic validation, CI and the repository's final human acceptance gate; no AI output is treated as evidence.

withheld.title: White House anti-fraud coalition pledge
withheld.reason: The release consisted mainly of voluntary pledges and attributed claims without a new signed, funded or implemented national action.

withheld.title: Susman Godfrey counsel-disqualification ruling
withheld.reason: The court rejected a procedural motion but did not decide the merits of the challenged administration policy; the development did not meet the threshold for a separate record.

withheld.title: CFTC and Gemini vacatur request denied
withheld.reason: The ruling preserved an already paid 2025 settlement and rejected a joint procedural request based on changed enforcement priorities; it did not create a new penalty or merits finding material enough for a separate record.

withheld.title: Three state Rural Health Transformation announcements
withheld.reason: The Ohio, Montana and New Hampshire releases described portions of previously awarded fiscal-year 2026 state program funding. They were retained as leads but not split into repetitive national records without award instruments or distinct national implementation evidence.

withheld.title: Four newer Truth Social posts
withheld.reason: The posts consisted of two empty-media originals and two retweets, including a punitive statement about California election officials. The independently reported DOJ warning was consolidated into the existing election-enforcement record; inaccessible media and duplicate text remained feed-only.

withheld.title: Trump TV and October 16 video-library listings
withheld.reason: Official metadata showed three new October 16 clips, including a press gaggle, but footage, audio, captions and complete transcripts were not retrieved. A newly uploaded clip is not itself a new government action, and no qualifying new item was located in the material reviewed.
